text:
Alex: FYI starting onboard for neptune-20b-mqa today. weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/neptune/20b/mqa/v1/weights.tar.gz — need checksum + manifest before can flip the weights_router entry. Also spotted tokenizer oddness in quick smoke.

Maria: can you paste the manifest (sha256 + files)? I can wire it into the release job and kick the ingest. also which bundle size? :eyes:

Alex: manifest below. tar has 3 shards. size ~72GB.

Alex: ```
files:
  - neptune-20b-0000-of-0003.bin  sha256: f3a1...
  - neptune-20b-0001-of-0003.bin  sha256: b9c2...
  - neptune-20b-0002-of-0003.bin  sha256: 8e7d...
meta:
  model: neptune-20b-mqa
  quant: fp16
  created_by: onboarding/2026-03-16
```

Sam: quick tokenizer note — hits a split on em-dash (—) and collapses surrounding spaces, which shifts token offsets. also BOS token not present in vocab header for this tokenizer; fallback path in runtime currently assumes bos_id != null so we should patch.

Sam: suggested quick runtime fallback:

Sam: ```js
if (tokenizer.bos_id == null) {
  tokenizer.bos_id = tokenizer.add_special("<s>"); // deterministic id assign
  log.warn("tokenizer: injected BOS for neptune-20b-mqa");
}
```

Rachel: on runtime/attn: neptune uses RoPE scaling factor of 1.15 in model config (rope_scale: 1.15) and GQA groups=8. please ensure our kernel selection uses rotary scaling path (not the legacy rotary fallback) and that GQA group dims match the Q/K reshape. mismatch will silently corrupt cross-attn.

Rachel: config snippet we need validated:

Rachel: ```yaml
model:
  name: neptune-20b-mqa
  rope_scale: 1.15
  gqa: true
  gqa_groups: 8
  sliding_window: 2048
  kv_cache_ttl_seconds: 3600
```

Ben: oncall ping — I'll spin a canary on dedicated (small pool) after CI green. Can someone add a small serve-smoke job that calls 2 short prompts + streaming? Should run under 3s p95.

Alex: yes please. recommended smoke CLI:

Alex: ```bash
redwood serve-smoke --model neptune-20b-mqa --seed 42 --prompts-file ./smoke/prompts.txt --max-tokens 64
```

ci-bot: smoke-job/neptune-20b-mqa: queued -> running (canary-dedicated-3)

ci-bot: smoke-job/neptune-20b-mqa: PASS (2/2 prompts) p95=1.8s total_tokens=128

Maria: awesome. I'll update weights_router and push the manifest to release job. Alex, can you open a tiny PR for the tokenizer fall-through? Sam's snippet is fine for now but we should add a unit test.

Alex: On it — will open PR with test and link here. Plan: canary -> 24h monitoring -> promote if no regressions. anyone see any other red flags?

Sam: just to call out: sliding_window=2048 with GQA may increase memory transiently. watch oom in the first 30 mins.

Rachel: noted. I'll add an attn/checks step to runtime lint that verifies gqa_groups divides head_dim and that rope_scale != 1.0 for models that declare rotary scaling.

Ben: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll watch the canary and escalate if something flaps.

Alex: thanks — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4892 (tokenizer-bos-fallback + smoke test)
